tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_list_acts
tools.description: List all available Acts in the database, with metadata and descriptions. Use this to see which legal codes are supported or find short codes. Currently supports 102 official Acts of India.

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_act_info
tools.description: Get metadata about one specific Act: its full name, year enacted, and whether it is still current law or has been repealed and replaced by something newer.

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_resolve_act
tools.description: [TOKEN OPTIMIZATION TOOL: Use this instead of list_acts to find act codes for any legal topic or statute name in a tiny, lightweight response.] Find the exact act_code(s) for any topic, statute name, or keyword. Returns a compact list of matching Acts with their act_code, official name, and enactmen

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_section
tools.description: [AI TOOL ORCHESTRATION INSTRUCTION: Only use this tool AFTER you have found the exact section number via search_keyword, or if the user explicitly provided it.] Get the exact text of ONE section (or Constitution article) by its number. Use this when someone asks about a specific, known section numbe

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_list_sections
tools.description: List every section NUMBER and TITLE in one Act, without the full body text. Use this to browse what exists in an Act before deciding which specific section or chapter to fetch in full -- much shorter than get_full_act.

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_chapter
tools.description: Get every section within one chapter (or Constitution Part) of an Act, with full text. Supports all chaptered Acts in the database (e.g. BNS, BNSS, BSA, IPC, CRPC, IEA, COI, CA, IBC, SEBI, SCRA, ITA, EA, DCA, LLP, MHA, MSMED, etc.). You can query by Roman numeral (e.g. 'I', 'III', 'VIA'), Arabic num

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_section_range
tools.description: Get all sections between a start and end number (inclusive) with full text. If start and end are provided in reverse order, it silently corrects them and includes a note in the response.

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_full_act
tools.description: Get an entire Act, in full, returned in paginated chunks (50 sections/page). Use only when genuinely needing the whole Act. If a page beyond the total pages is requested, it gracefully returns empty sections with a note.

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_search_keyword
tools.description: [AI TOOL ORCHESTRATION INSTRUCTION: ALWAYS use this tool FIRST when the specific section number is unknown. Never guess section numbers.] Search section titles and text across all 102 Acts (including the 2026 Constitution of India, criminal, civil, commercial, corporate, labor, tax, environmental, p

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_convert_section
tools.description: Map/convert any criminal law section between the old repealed codes (IPC, CrPC, IEA) and the new 2023 criminal codes (BNS, BNSS, BSA) in either direction. Returns the corresponding section number, amendment status ('Retained', 'Change', 'Deleted', 'New Section', 'New Sub-Section'), a concise mapping

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_constitution_schedule
tools.description: Get the full text and tables of a specific Schedule of the Constitution of India (2026 Edition). Covers all 12 Schedules (First to Twelfth Schedule). Examples: get_constitution_schedule('Seventh') -> Union, State, and Concurrent Lists get_constitution_schedule('7') -> Same as 'Seventh' get_constitut

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_list_constitution_schedules
tools.description: List all 12 Schedules of the Constitution of India with their numbers and titles.

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_constitution_appendix
tools.description: Get the full text of an Appendix to the Constitution of India (2026 Edition). Covers Appendix I (100th Amendment / Land Boundary Agreement), Appendix II (J&K Order 2019 / C.O. 272), and Appendix III (Declaration under Article 370(3) / C.O. 273).

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_list_constitution_appendices
tools.description: List all 3 Appendices of the Constitution of India with their numbers and titles.

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_list_skills
tools.description: Discover expert legal research procedures and workflows available in the system. Returns the skills registry containing domain skill IDs, titles, triggers ('use_when'), covered act codes, recommended tool sequences, and reference files. If query is provided, filters skills by keyword matching agains

tools.name: indian_legal_mcp_get_skill
tools.description: Retrieve procedural instructions and domain reference files for a legal skill. Call this tool after checking list_skills to load the exact workflow for a legal domain. Use skill_id='_core' to retrieve global legal reasoning, citation, and anti-hallucination rules.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "indian_legal_mcp_search_keyword" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "indian_legal_mcp_list_acts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
